conclusion: L0-L3 conditioning states are computable from same-scan already-loaded inputs with existing research observers and zero new market-data calls, but the legacy mutable/bounded Shadow archive is not promotion-grade evidence. L4 ranking/selection parentage also needs immutable actual decision-state linkage.

blockers: legacy REJECTED_AFTER_BASE is bounded max 6 per pool and sorted by first exclusion reason
first-failure count does not identify overlapping gate eligibility
legacy BROAD_CONTROL is sampled and quota-conditioned
observer not immutably attached to complete per-symbol decision-state parent for every candidate
channel/geometry cannot be manufactured for rows that never validly reached required setup state
same-date mutable archive lacks immutable generation
TARGET_NULL must remain separate from LOW_RR
legacy RR-reject representation is not prevalence-complete

layerAudit.computation: actual formal result + post-consensus ranking tuple + selected membership
blockers: legacy selected/QNS and control rows do not share one immutable per-symbol decision parent
BROAD_CONTROL can recompute bare scoreCandidate and diverge from post-consensus formal ranking state
single cohort primary key prevents overlapping semantic memberships
reader limits can truncate complete keyspace

requiredFutureParent.architecture: reuse SHADOW_COHORT_SEMANTICS_CLASS_B_PROPOSAL immutable per-symbol decision-state parent; do not create a parallel ATR-specific parent
requiredFutureParent.membership: overlapping research memberships reference the same immutable parent

biasFindings: Selection bias: studying only final selected rows conditions on ATR/RR/grade/ranking survival.
First-failure bias: exclusion_reason is ordered first failure, not independent ATR rejection contribution.
Sampling bias: REJECTED_AFTER_BASE and BROAD_CONTROL are bounded and not prevalence-complete.
Consensus provenance bias: recomputed control score can differ from actual post-consensus formal decision state.
Target provenance bias: a present target value is not automatically PIT-valid.
Reader truncation risk: bounded legacy readers can omit newest/partial-date evidence.

decision.reason: Promotion-grade denominator and immutable parent are not yet available. Outcome lookup on legacy convenience cohorts would compound selection/sampling/provenance bias.
decision.next: Reuse the existing shared Class-B immutable decision-state parent proposal if owner-authorized; until then keep ATR outcome research blocked rather than fabricate counterfactuals.
